content.text: Use the Agent tool with run_in_background true to delegate this: run the shell command `sleep 30; cat data.txt` and report the magic number. Do not wait for it; reply right away with the single word launched.
While that sub-agent is still running, use SendMessage to send it this extra instruction: also report the number plus one. Do not start a new agent. Then wait for its result and tell me both numbers.
